title: Characterization of spacetime singularities for the Schrödinger equation by initial state
summary: We discuss spacetime singularities of a solution to the Schrödinger equation with a metric perturbation and a sublinear potential. The quasi-homogeneous wave front set, due to Lascar (1977), of a solution is characterized by that of the free solution, and a classical high-energy scattering data. In the one-dimensional case, it further reduces to the homogeneous wave front set, due to Nakamura (2005), of the initial time-slice.
